# AddCertificateRequest

Specifies the parameters to add certificate to certificate store.

## Properties

Name | Type | Description | Notes
------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**action** | **str** | Specifies that whether cert is to be imported or is to be generated by Cohesity. Set it to Generate in case Cohesity needs to generate the certificate. Set it to Import in case cert-bundle is being imported. | 
**certificate_generate_params** | [**GenerateNewStoreCertificateRequest**](GenerateNewStoreCertificateRequest.md) |  | [optional] 
**certificate_import_params** | [**ImportCertBundleRequest**](ImportCertBundleRequest.md) |  | [optional] 
**environment** | **str** | Specifies the certificate store environment type. Based on this environment type, corresponding certificate store will be used. | [optional]
